Merge pull request #7 from schoad/bugfix/simplify-infura-check

bugfix: improve handling of 403 errors and network detection

bugfix: improve handling of 403 errors and network detection

Add specific handling for 403 Forbidden responses and network
detection errors from Infura. Different error types now trigger
different behaviors:

- 403 errors stop retry attempts immediately
- Network detection errors don't count against retry limit
- Project ID rejections stop immediately
- Other errors increment retry counter

This provides better error handling and prevents unnecessary
retries when the connection is explicitly forbidden.
